debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr.

policy.description: Policy for handling multiple services (e.g., 'first_ok' = stop after first successful update).

plugin_dir.description: Directory where plugin modules (.py or .so) are stored.

data_dir.description: Directory for runtime data (e.g., last IP cache).

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 detection and updates if available.

services.description: List of named services to enable (each service has a plugin and optional custom options).

plugin.description: Name of the plugin to use (e.g., 'dnsimple', 'cloudflare').

hosts.description: List of hostname entries to update.

hostname.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) to update.

provider.description: Service provider name (must match one defined in 'services').

plugin.description: Override plugin name (if different from service's plugin). Optional.

global_options.description: Global plugin configuration (e.g., default credentials, API tokens). Used when per-service options are absent.

log_file.description: Path to log file (if empty, logs to stderr only).
